articles.summary: ( NASDAQ: ALGT ) today added two new year-round nonstop routes from Flint Bishop International Airport (FNT) to Orlando International Airport (MCO) and Southwest Florida International Airport (RSW), with limited time one-way fares as low as $69*. Due to popular demand, the airline is also adding flights to two existing routes from FNT to Sarasota Bradenton International Airport (SRQ) and St. Pete-Clearwater International Airport (PIE), expanding its network with additional affordable travel options. Launching in late winter 2027, the new routes will offer convenient nonstop service between these cities while strengthening Allegiant's presence in popular leisure destinations. The airline is known for connecting small to mid-size cities to larger markets. As more people seek value-driven travel options, Allegiant remains dedicated to making dream vacations possible with budget-friendly fares and excellent customer service. articles.title: Allegiant Announces Two New Nonstop Routes Connecting Flint-Area to Premier Florida Destinations

articles.summary: ( NASDAQ: ALGT ) has been named 2026's Best Low-Cost Airline in North America by Skytrax, the international air transport rating organization, marking the third consecutive year Allegiant has won the award. The airline received the recognition today during Skytrax's World Airline Awards ceremony held in London, known throughout the industry as the "Oscars of aviation" for its recognition of outstanding customer service. "Three years running is a reflection of the consistency our team members bring to every flight," said Greg Anderson, Allegiant's Chief Executive Officer. "As we grow, our commitment to delivering a seamless, comfortable and convenient travel experience for our customers hasn't changed, and this recognition tells us that focus is resonating with the people who matter most: our passengers."
